motifs.name: rear_snow_peak
motifs.description: Isolate the tall pale snow-covered mountain peak in the upper left background, including its sharp summit, sloping ridges, shaded left flank, and faint wash transitions into surrounding mist. Exclude the calligraphy at upper right and the separate central foreground mountain.
must_preserve: thin contour line along both mountain edges
soft pale snow wash on the broad face
dark stippled and dry-brush texture near the summit and ridge shoulders
faint vertical wash marks on the mountain face
mist-softened lower edge where the peak recedes behind nearer forms

must_preserve: dark ink crest strokes at the upper ridge
sharp angular outline of the snow-covered slopes
vertical cracked rock linework on the right face
soft gray-brown wash pooling at the base
dry-brush streaks and pale reserve areas defining snowy planes

must_preserve: gnarled warm-brown trunk contours
individual branching structure and forked limbs
blue-green pine needle rosettes and clustered tips
fine ink outlines around needles
layering of branches over the misty background

motifs.name: left_waterside_pavilions
motifs.description: Isolate the left lower waterside pavilion group: snow-dusted roofed buildings on the shoreline with wooden posts, railing, windows, small porch platform, and tiny seated interior figures. Include the immediate rocky bank and shrubs that support the architecture, but exclude the large pine canopy and foreground cliff rock as much as possible.
must_preserve: low sloping roof geometry with pale snow cover
fine wooden post and window lattice linework
small porch railing and platform edges
tiny human figures visible inside the open pavilion
ink-and-color shrubs around the foundations
subtle ocher and gray wash accents on walls and rocks

thin ink outline along the upper ridge
dry-brush gray shading under the curve

soft misty water edge around the form
